doc:
### PROPOSAL-01 — Cel-Shading - **slug**: `cel-shading` - **Vibe**: Flat, crisp anime/game-keyframe UI where every surface is a hard-edged color block with an offset ink shadow. - **Best for**: Creator Studio and Ad Wizard — video-combinatorial flows feel like building a game asset. Adjectives: playful, crisp, high-energy. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#140f26` | Deep night-sky violet; app canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#211a3a` | Flat panel fill; cards, sidebars | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#2d2447` | Raised panels, popovers, hover fills | | `--border-subtle` | `#3a2f5c` | Hairline separation between panels | | `--border-default` | `#4a3d70` | Standard card/form borders | | `--border-focus` | `#ffd54f` | Hard yellow "keyframe highlight" outline | | `--text-primary` | `#fdfbff` | Headings and emphasis on dark fills | | `--text-secondary` | `#c9c2e6` | Standard body text | | `--text-muted` | `#8f86b8` | Helper text, dates, captions | | `--color-action` | `#ff6a1a` | Hero-orange primary action fills | | `--color-action-hover` | `#e85a0e` | Action hover (deeper orange) | | `--color-earnings` | `#ffd54f` | Coin-gold earnings, revenue, profit | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#f2c21f` | Earnings hover (deeper gold) | | `--color-automation` | `#38e1ff` | Cel-cyan; Playwright/AI/terminal accents | | `--color-alert` | `#ffb300` | Warnings, pending, publishing pulse | | `--color-danger` | `#ff4d5e` | Failed status, destructive actions | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(255, 106, 26, 0.16)` | Soft tint behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(255, 213, 79, 0.16)` | Soft tint behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(56, 225, 255, 0.16)` | Soft tint behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Fredoka", "Baloo 2", system-ui, sans-serif` at 600-700 weight, tight leading. Sans: `"Nunito", "Inter", system-ui, sans-serif` at 500-700. Mono: `"Space Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` for timestamps and IDs. Headings use `letter-spacing: 0.01em`; numeric KPIs enforce `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Chunky-but-friendly: cards `rounded-xl` (0.75rem), buttons pill (`rounded-full`), inputs `rounded-md`. 2px borders. The signature is the **hard offset shadow**: a solid 4px shadow (`0 4px 0 0 #0d0a1a`) with zero blur — no soft shadows anywhere. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Primary = flat saturated fill with dark ink text (`#140f26`) + 4px hard offset shadow; hover "presses down" (shadow shrinks to 1px). Secondary = transparent with 2px border. Tertiary = text-only with underline on hover. Focus-visible = 2px `--border-focus` outline. Sharp-edged, never ghosted. - **Cards**: Flat surface fill, hard offset shadow, 2px border. No gradients, no blur. Hover raises the offset shadow from 4px to 6px. KPI cards get a colored top "keyframe strip" (action/earnings/automation). - **Badges/Status**: Pill with a square status dot (cel style, not round); publishing status uses the pulsing gold "spark". Failed = red pill with dark text. - **Tables**: Two flat alternating row fills (`surface` / `surface-elevated`), no zebra glow; header row has a hard 2px underline and uppercase micro-labels. Hover = left 3px action strip. - **Forms/Inputs**: Flat fills, 2px borders, no inner glow; focus = yellow border only. Error text sits inline below the field with a small square alert glyph. - **Loading**: A bouncing 3-block "sprite" (three squares that hop in sequence, 120ms per hop). Determinate progress = segmented blocks filling one-by-one. - **Signature detail**: The 4px hard offset "cel shadow" on every interactive surface — the one unmistakable cue that this is cel-shaded, not soft-shadow UI. - **Motion & Animation**: Snappy and stepped (`cubic-bezier(0.9, 0, 0.1, 1)`, 100-150ms). Turbo Stream entries "pop" in (scale 0.9 to 1) without opacity fades. Buttons compress on `:active` like a keyframe squash. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
Earnings / 30d $12,480.50 +14.2% vs last month
```
